releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.64 — the update is now a proper page, and mentions are called mentions. (1) When a new build is available, NChat opens a full screen instead of a small floating card: a clear 'Update available' heading, the version step (installed → new), the full release notes in a scrollable panel that never cuts a sentence, and two obvious choices — Not now, or Update now — with the download percentage shown while it runs. The back gesture means 'not now'; it is ignored while the download is in progress. (2) If someone mentions you in a group, the notification title says so — 'Team · you were mentioned' — instead of looking like every other message in that group. Mentions are plain text between phones, so the title is the one place that difference can be shown.
